entries.name: late-address-response
entries.claim: A late provider reply cannot attach coordinates after the source changes.

kills.name: Address publication preserves the old envelope, stops the prior reader, and serves governed user text without a provider
kills.expected: the late geocode was accepted after the source address changed

entries.name: shared-record-company-pin
entries.claim: A shared record returns only the selected company installation’s provider pin.
entries.original:
AND g.company_id = scope_company
     AND g.installation_id = scope_installation

kills.name: Address publication preserves the old envelope, stops the prior reader, and serves governed user text without a provider
kills.expected: the other company received a provider pin for this shared record

entries.name: address-configure-needs-permission
entries.claim: Enabling or configuring a provider needs the declared configure permission in a live grant.

kills.name: configuring a provider needs the declared write permission, checked live
kills.expected: a principal without the configure permission enabled a provider

entries.name: address-configure-demo-store
entries.claim: Until SIGNIN-1 slice 2b, a provider is enabled only in a store claimed for the local demo.
entries.original:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM north_star_internal.staff_store_mode WHERE mode = 'demo') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'address.configureNeedsDecisionProof' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;

kills.name: outside a store claimed for the local demo, enabling a provider refuses
kills.expected: a provider was enabled outside a store claimed for the local demo

entries.name: address-installation-read-for-members
entries.claim: Any member of the company reads its installation; reading never needs the configure permission.
entries.original:
IF NOT north_star_internal.address_member(scope_company) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
entries.replacement:
IF NOT north_star_internal.address_may_configure(scope_company) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY

kills.name: a non-manager buyer locates, reads pins and gets suggestions
kills.expected: a non-manager job was held instead of located

entries.name: address-pin-survives-activation
entries.claim: A pin is matched on record, field, revision and installation, never on the current release fence.
entries.replacement:
AND g.address_revision = scope_revision
     AND g.fence = (SELECT p.fence FROM platform.active_release_pointers p WHERE (p.tenant_id,p.environment_id) = (g.tenant_id,g.environment_id))

kills.name: an unrelated activation keeps a located pin visible
kills.expected: an unrelated activation hid a located pin

entries.name: address-membership-company-scope
entries.claim: A company-scoped membership reaches only its own company through every address function.
entries.original:
AND m.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (m.legal_entity_id IS NULL OR m.legal_entity_id = scope_company))
entries.replacement: AND m.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.revoked_at IS NULL)

kills.name: a company-scoped principal reaches no other company through the address functions
kills.expected: a company-scoped principal listed another company installation

entries.name: address-pin-company-predicate
entries.claim: The pin read matches the caller’s company, not only the installation it names.

kills.name: the pin read matches its own company, not only the installation named
kills.expected: company A read company B pin by naming its installation

entries.name: address-pin-installation-predicate
entries.claim: Only the current installation’s enrichment supplies a pin.

kills.name: the pin read matches the current installation
kills.expected: a replaced installation still supplied the pin

entries.name: address-owned-record-predicate
entries.claim: An owned record’s address is read only for its stored company.

kills.name: an owned record is read only for its stored company
kills.expected: the owned-record predicate let company A read company B record

entries.name: address-enqueue-stored-owner
entries.claim: Saving an owned record queues a geocode only for its stored company.

kills.name: saving an owned record queues only for its stored company
kills.expected: a save queued a geocode for a company that does not own the record

entries.name: address-sweep-batch-limit
entries.claim: The coordinate sweeper scrubs at most its batch per call.

kills.name: expired provider coordinates are scrubbed in bounded batches
kills.expected: the sweeper exceeded its batch

entries.name: address-sweep-expiry-only
entries.claim: The coordinate sweeper scrubs only expired provider coordinates.

kills.name: expired provider coordinates are scrubbed in bounded batches
kills.expected: the sweeper scrubbed unexpired coordinates

entries.name: address-quota-call-limit
entries.claim: A call beyond the period call limit is refused.

kills.name: the call limit refuses once spent
kills.expected: a call beyond the period limit was reserved

entries.name: address-quota-budget-limit
entries.claim: A call beyond the period budget is refused.

kills.name: the budget refuses a call it cannot cover
kills.expected: a call beyond the period budget was reserved

entries.name: address-quota-first-call-cost
entries.claim: A first call costing more than the budget is refused.
entries.original: IF cost > installed.period_budget_micros THEN RETURN false; END IF;

kills.name: a budget below one call refuses the first
kills.expected: a first call costing more than the budget was reserved

entries.name: address-installation-identity-reuse
entries.claim: Re-enabling a provider account reuses its installation, so its quota and key entry survive.
entries.original: AND i.provider = requested_provider AND i.account = requested_account
entries.replacement: AND i.provider = requested_provider AND i.account = requested_account AND false

kills.name: quota follows the provider account through pause and switching
kills.expected: pausing and re-enabling one account minted a new installation

entries.name: address-late-revision-recheck
entries.claim: A late geocode is refused when the address revision moved, even to the same text.

kills.name: a late geocode rechecks the address revision
kills.expected: a late geocode was accepted for a superseded revision

entries.name: address-late-installation-recheck
entries.claim: A late geocode is refused when the company installation changed.

kills.name: a late geocode rechecks the installation
kills.expected: a late geocode was accepted after the installation changed

entries.name: address-late-enrichment-recheck
entries.claim: A late geocode is refused when enrichment was switched off.

kills.name: a late geocode rechecks enrichment
kills.expected: a late geocode was accepted after enrichment was switched off

entries.name: address-configure-lock-order
entries.claim: Concurrent configure calls for one company serialize instead of deadlocking.

kills.name: concurrent configure calls for one company serialize
kills.expected: concurrent configure calls deadlocked

entries.name: address-history-replaced-installation
entries.claim: A replaced installation is recorded as paused.

kills.name: a replaced installation gets its own history row
kills.expected: the replaced installation has no history row

entries.name: address-provider-error-scrub
entries.claim: A provider failure surfaces only its reason, never the request that carried the key.

kills.name: a canary provider key never reaches errors, rows, tool results or output
kills.expected: a provider error carried the canary key

entries.name: address-map-placement-reader-floor
entries.claim: A map placement raises the surface floor to 32, so a reader 31 build refuses it.

kills.name: Address publication preserves the old envelope, stops the prior reader, and serves governed user text without a provider
kills.expected: a reader 31 build did not refuse a map placement release by its floor

entries.name: address-loader-link-declaration
entries.claim: The loader refuses a connector link without its declaration.

kills.name: the loader refuses a connector link without its declaration
kills.expected: a linked but undeclared connector was served

entries.name: address-loader-consumer-declaration
entries.claim: The loader refuses an Address consumer without a connector declaration.

kills.name: a surface bound to Address without a connector declaration refuses to load
kills.expected: an Address consumer without a declaration was served

entries.name: address-loader-floor-without-consumer
entries.claim: The loader refuses an Address floor without an Address consumer.

kills.name: an Address map floor without an Address consumer refuses to load
kills.expected: an Address floor without a consumer was served

entries.name: address-loader-placement-floor
entries.claim: The loader refuses a map placement below the map reader floor.

kills.name: the loader refuses a map placement below the map reader floor
kills.expected: a map placement was served at the Address field floor

entries.name: address-loader-consumer-bindings
entries.claim: The loader refuses a consumer that pins different Address bindings.
